messages:
sara-ux: Dropping the 'roles snapshot' comp for review. New ideas: a tiny SSO policy column, a print/export friendly table, and an accessible SR-only summary for screen readers. Looking for quick takes on copy + audit deep-links.

dan-eng: From eng side: fine with SSO policy column but please keep the API to return an explicit effective_sso string so UI and audit match. Also watch large-table rendering when exporting CSV/print.

sara-ux: Agreed. Export should respect current filters and visible columns. For print we hide action menus and show inline text like "SSO: Org managed".

olivia-security: Security notes: every SSO toggle or role change needs an audit event including prior_value, new_value, actor_id, and a human-readable reason when available. For exports, redact local-parts of emails unless user has data export permission.

sara-ux: Good catch on redaction. I'll add copy that explains redaction in the export modal: "Emails are partially redacted in exports for privacy unless you have data export permissions."

leo-pm: Product question: should the SSO policy column show two states (Org / Override) or three (Org / Override / Unknown)? Unknown applies when membership comes from an external identity provider sync.

d an-eng: (typo: dan) Server will return "unknown" for synced identities. UI should render a tooltip explaining that the identity comes from an external IDP and SSO enforcement may be managed externally.

sara-ux: For compact rows I want to use short badges: "Org" / "Ov" / "??" with aria-labels. Expanded rows show full text. Also proposing an SR-only summary above the table for keyboard/screen-reader users: e.g., "Showing 42 roles. 12 roles have SSO managed at org level, 2 have overrides."

a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: ensure badges include text, provide aria-live region when policy changes, and implement prefers-reduced-motion for row animations. Also screen reader summary OK if updated on filter changes.

olivia-security: Audit deep-links: when user clicks "View audit" in a role row we should open /audit with params role_id, events=(sso_change,role_assignment), window=30d. Please include a code sample in the UI that generates stable links.

dan-eng: Sample deep-link format we can support:

```
/audit?role_id=role_123&events=sso_change,role_assignment&from=2025-02-01&to=2025-03-03
```
We will validate params server-side and limit heavy queries.

sara-ux: UX copy tweak: change tooltip text from "Enable SSO for role" to "Allow sign-in via your organization's SSO for members of this role." Olivia suggested avoiding "enable" which sounds like a new feature.

leo-pm: Also add a small inline hint for admin-level roles: "Admin roles affect org security. Changes require confirmation." That should reduce accidental escalations.

a11y-bot: Micro-nit: confirmation checkbox must be focusable before Confirm button is enabled, and its state should be exposed via aria-checked. Also announce the count of affected users when modal opens.

dan-eng: Implementation note: we'll add a telemetry event for role_snapshot_export and role_audit_deeplink_click so we can see how often people use exports vs the audit UI.

sara-ux: Another new idea: role "snapshots" — save a read-only picture of the role at a point in time (members + SSO policy). Useful for compliance. Snapshot export should include a permalink to the audit filtered to relevant events.

olivia-security: Snapshots are helpful. Ensure snapshots include the actor who took the snapshot and that creating a snapshot emits an audit event. Also snapshot files should note whether emails were redacted.

sara-ux: I'll add UI for "Save snapshot" in the role detail panel that opens a small modal with filename and redaction checkbox (if user has permission).

d an-eng: (typo again) We'll add backend support: POST /roles/{id}/snapshots -> returns snapshot_id + audit_deeplink.

leo-pm: Acceptance criteria idea: 1) SSO policy column present in both compact/expanded; 2) exports & snapshots redact PII unless permitted; 3) audit deep-links prefill role + event types + time window; 4) confirmation flows for admin changes; 5) a11y SR-summary and keyboard nav documented.

a11y-bot: Auto-checklist: [x] badge text present, [x] aria-labels added, [ ] aria-live on policy changes, [x] reduced-motion respected, [ ] keyboard flow verification scheduled.

sara-ux: Thanks everyone. I'll update comps with snapshot flows, export modal copy, and the SR-only summary. Will post final pass with Figma link and a short QA checklist. :sparkles:
